findingClass: an ipos provenance row written from a filing document (field_sources.source = 'DRHP', the source every filing doc type writes) whose data_lineage names no document (no documentId). The filing path passed its lineage to every child table and ipo_details but not to upsertIPO, so every DRHP-source ipos row it wrote was anonymous (#993; staging 2026-09-25: 331 of 331 rows, 58 IPOs) and the item 6 DOC fetcher credited whichever COMPLETED document it found first instead of the one that wrote the value.
failThreshold: any field_sources row with table_name = 'ipos', source = 'DRHP', data_lineage->>'documentId' IS NULL and updated_at within the last 24 hours (fixed threshold: after #993 every filing-path write carries the id, so a fresh anonymous row is a write path that dropped it). Rows written before the fix are outside the 24h window by construction and are the repair tool's population, not this check's.
note: Detection upgrade for #993 (provenance-write-drops-the-document-id). scraper/scripts/repair-ipos-lineage-document-id.ts stamps the EXISTING rows where exactly one COMPLETED filing of the same IPO completed within 10 s after the row was written (dry-run default; staging dry run 2026-09-25: 156 of 331 stampable, 110 no candidate, 65 several candidates left alone).
